page.overview:
What is Siege of Bomis Koori?

The siege of Bomis Koori took place in 6 ABY during the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor. It saw the defeat of warlord Utoxx Prentioch at the hands of Admiral Firmus Nantz and the New Republic's First Fleet. Prentioch was captured in the fighting and his warlord empire fell as a result.
